# Narrative contract

Central question: can an exact four-dimensional non-Abelian finite block carry
gauge reduction, nonlinear local control, retained/fiber conditioning, and one
mathematically controlled marginalization in a single reproducible theorem?

Narrative chain:

1. Constructive RG requires several representation changes to preserve
   different structures.
2. A hidden Jacobian or floating spectral claim breaks that chain.
3. Rooted tree gauge and exact arithmetic remove those two ambiguities.
4. Analytic product-log and heat-kernel bounds place the exact action in a
   uniformly convex local cylinder.
5. Brascamp--Lieb and transport inequalities convert the local action norm into
   a normalized conditional and effective-action theorem.
6. The exact result is a one-block interface, not a repeated RG or mass-gap
   theorem.

Abstract claims map only to Theorem 5.1, Proposition 5.2, or certificate
outputs. The conclusion repeats the same block, radius, time, and scope.

Sentences requiring citations: heat-kernel regulator history; Villain
relation; Balaban comparisons; maximal-tree precedent; Brascamp--Lieb;
Otto--Villani; Clay target. All are cited in the manuscript.
